verdict.rationale: Metorial documents letting developers upload custom MCP server code for Metorial to host, scale, and monitor (metorial-docs-5, metorial-docs-23), which covers the 'custom code → hosted MCP server' half of the story, but there is no evidence of an OpenAPI-spec import/auto-generation path, and the custom-code path still implies writing MCP-server code rather than eliminating protocol plumbing entirely. Missing for 10: OpenAPI-to-MCP-server generation/import feature, and confirmation that uploaded 'custom code' is plain business logic rather than MCP-protocol code the developer must write.
